description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of five different methods. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis represents the value and is labeled "Average Performance," utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 60 with numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 10, accompanied by horizontal dashed grid lines. The chart features five individual vertical bars, each rendered in a distinct color. The first bar, Standard, is brownish-gold and has an approximate value of 53. The second bar, Self-RAG, is olive-brown with a value near 54. The third bar, FactTune, is olive-green and represents the shortest bar on the chart with a value of approximately 52. The fourth bar, CInGS (w/), is slate grey and reaches about 54. The final bar, CInGS, is dark blue and represents the tallest bar at approximately 59. The bars are not grouped or stacked, nor are they sorted by height, and there are no specific visual annotations or emphasized outlines beyond the distinct coloring of each bar against the dark grey background.
